visualize_coco_predictions: run the script to visualize COCO JSON predictions as images with bounding boxes and labels
visualize_lvis_predictions: run the script to visualize LVIS JSON predictions side by side with ground truth annotations
create_instances_from_predictions: create detectron2 Instances objects from a list of prediction dictionaries with scores and bounding boxes
filter_predictions_by_confidence: filter model predictions by confidence threshold and convert bounding box format from XYWH to XYXY
draw_instance_predictions: draw predicted instance bounding boxes and masks on images using detectron2 Visualizer
